description: The reserved agent group every enrollment group owns exactly once, created with the tenant. It collects the agents that were activated without an agent group, so the navigation tree has a node to render and the API an id to scope by.
comment: A distinct interface rather than an instance of the ordinary agent group because it carries no ChildAgentGroups: it sits at depth 1, holds no children, and is neither renamable, movable nor deletable.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Always the reserved literal 'unassigned'. Forms the path segment of this agent group within the unified namespace.
contents.comment: Reserved at depth 1, so a create, rename or move that would claim it is rejected - the name is set once with the tenant and never written again. Never translated either: a path must resolve to the same agent group in every locale. Localized labels belong in DisplayNames.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for the unassigned agent group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT). Seeded with the tenant and not customer-editable.

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of the unassigned agent group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT). Seeded with the tenant and not customer-editable.

contents.name: Agents
contents.description: Agents that hold no agent group assignment within this enrollment group.
contents.comment: Bounded by the enrollment group's agent count rather than the per-group fan-out, because this group is where every agent activated without a group lands and where agents predating the feature are backfilled. Verified: the node does not enforce maxMultiplicity on write, so this bound documents intent rather than a limit the platform upholds.
